scope: All65selected event records, preserve V1/V2 duplicates and all overlapping native orders. Display original raw counts, positive background-subtracted excess and native side-normalized profiles in selected-event order. No score ranking.
interpretation: Separate provisional morphology judgments; original production unchanged. Strong raw charge morphology can support particle/artifact, wavelength plus photon-compatible raw morphology can support provisional atmospheric feature, otherwise unresolved spectral feature or insufficient mapping. No automatic origin veto from wavelength, score or plotting scale. Possible sky+particle blends retained.
mapping: Inherited global reference grid and two-sided spatial-offset check. Local correlations descriptive, not extra pass criterion. All unverified overlapping orders remain explicit.
review_scope: Primary AI-agent judgments withheld until separate AI-agent review is written. Both agents know selection, detector context and previous project findings; not blinded scientific validation and not human review.
figures: Four events per page, all arrays retained, every order scaled separately for legibility. Follow-up enlarged figures allowed if ambiguity recorded; no new classification thresholds.
